IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: OPERATION OF A PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL SERVING STUDENTS IN KINDERGARTEN THROUGH TWELFTH GRADE.
IRS990.MissionDesc: LITERACY FIRST CHARTER SCHOOLS EXISTS TO NURTURE THE WHOLE CHILD FROM KINDERGARTEN THROUGH HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION BY IGNITING A PASSION FOR COMPREHENSIVE LITERACY AND EQUIPPING EACH CHILD TO WHOLEHEARTEDLY PARTICIPATE IN THEIR COMMUNITY.
IRS990.Desc: OPERATION OF A PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL SERVING STUDENTS IN GRADES K TO 12: LITERACY FIRST VIEWS EDUCATION AS A PROCESS, NOT A PRODUCT, WHICH ENABLES STUDENTS TO GO FROM LEARNING TO READ, TO READING TO LEARN. LFCS DESIRES TO SHAPE LITERATE, LIFE-LONG LEARNERS, INDEPENDENT THINKERS, TECHNOLOGICALLY LITERATE CITIZENS, ENTHUSIASTIC AND HIGHLY QUALIFIED TEACHERS, RELIABLE ASSESSMENTS THAT PROVIDE STUDENTS A PRODUCTIVE EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE, ASPIRING LEADERS WHO POSITIVELY IMPACT THEIR COMMUNITY, COMMUNITY THAT UNDERSTANDS AND SUPPORTS THE MISSION OF LFCS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MANAGEMENT BELIEVES ALL OF ITS SIGNIFICANT TAX POSITIONS WOULD BE UPHELD UNDER EXAMINATION; THEREFORE, NO PROVISION FOR INCOME TAX HAS BEEN RECORDED.
THE POLICY IS DISCLOSED ON THE SCHOOL WEBSITE AS WELL AS WITHIN THE SCHOOL'S CHARTER PETITION.
THE ORGANIZATION IS A TUITION-FREE PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL; THEREFORE, SCHOLARSHIPS AND FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE ARE NOT APPLICABLE.
AS A PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL, THE ORGANIZATION RECEIVES GOVERNMENTAL FUNDING FROM THE U.S. AND CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENTS OF EDUCATION AS WELL AS PROPERTY TAXES PASSED THROUGH THE LOCAL SCHOOL DISTRICT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 2
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FINANCIAL OFFICER (OFFICER) HOLDS A RELATIONSHIP WITH THE ASSISTANT PRINCIPAL (KEY EMPLOYEE). THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR (OFFICER) HOLDS A RELATIONSHIP WITH SPED ADMINISTRATOR (HIGHLY COMPENSATED EMPLOYEE).

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED AND FINALIZED BY THE FINANCIAL OFFICER AND THEN ADOPTED BY THE BOARD IN A PUBLIC MEETING FOLLOWING SUBMISSION TO THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MANAGEMENT AND THE BOARD ARE REQUIRED TO ANNUALLY COMPLETE A CA FORM 700 STATEMENT OF ECONOMIC INTERESTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD REVIEWS COMPENSATION FOR SIMILAR POSITIONS FOR NEIGHBORING SCHOOLS. COMPENSATION IS APPROVED AT A PUBLIC BOARD MEETING AND EXECUTED WITH A WRITTEN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: PUBLIC DOCUMENTS ARE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
